title: System Inventory Management
description: Build a complete inventory system using all Collections library features: lists, dicts, sorting, filtering, nested data.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "We need a complete ship inventory system. Track all components with properties (name, type, status, priority). Sort by priority, filter by status, generate reports. Use every Collections skill you've learned."
story.context: Production automation involves complex data management. This challenge simulates real inventory/asset management systems using Collections library.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Outstanding! You built a full inventory system—created nested data, sorted by priority, filtered critical items, generated statistics. This is production-grade data management!"

instructions: - Create 5 component dictionaries with fields: name, type, status, priority
- Component 2: name=Power Core    type=Power    status=Online    priority=1
- Component 3: name=Backup Power    type=Power    status=Offline    priority=3
- Component 4: name=Main Engine    type=Propulsion    status=Online    priority=1
- Component 5: name=Life Support    type=Life Support    status=Online    priority=1
- IF status == 'Offline', append component name to ${offline}
- List Should Contain Value    ${offline}    Backup Power
- Log summary: Total, Online, Offline counts
hints: Store inventory as global/suite variable or rebuild in each test
Use FOR + IF to filter by criteria
Append To List builds filtered lists
Get From Dictionary extracts component properties
List Should Contain Value validates list membership
Count items by incrementing variable in loop

theory.title: Challenge 4.1: System Inventory Management
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "This is real-world data management, PROTO-7. Inventory systems, asset tracking, configuration management—all use these patterns. Build, query, filter, report. You're doing what enterprise automation does every day."

Complete Data Management Workflow

Production systems need:

  • Data modeling: Lists of dicts for records
  • Filtering: FOR + IF to find matching items
  • Aggregation: Count, sum, categorize
  • Validation: Assertions on filtered results
  • Reporting: Summary statistics and logs

This challenge combines all Collections skills into one cohesive system.

⚠️ Challenge Architecture

  • Suite variable: @{INVENTORY} shared across tests
  • Nested data: List of component dicts (6 components)
  • Filtering pattern: FOR + IF + Append To List
  • Counting pattern: Variable increment in loop
  • Validation: List Should Contain Value checks
  • This scales to 1000+ items with same code

Real-World Applications

This challenge demonstrates patterns used in:

  • Asset/inventory management systems
  • Configuration management databases (CMDB)
  • Test result aggregation and reporting
  • API response filtering and validation
  • Database query result processing

You've mastered Collections library—a critical skill for data-driven automation.
